title: WOLFENSTEIN: ENEMY TERRITORY
subtitle: Splash Damage / id Software, 2003 · 2.60, the GPL source — Linux/GLX, native cgame, qagame and ui
argsHint: `+map <name>` loads a map (oasis, battery, goldrush, radar, railgun, fueldump); without it the game opens on its menu. net_noudp 1: the page has no sockets.

needsData.hint: etmain/ of the free 2.60b release: pak0.pk3, pak1.pk3, pak2.pk3

_why: id Tech 3 again, but its game logic is native code, not QVM: cgame, qagame and ui are shared objects the engine dlopens, built here by PRISM as three modules with their own namespaces.
